ArrowDistance.Name: Indicator distance
ArrowDistance.Hint: How far from the token center the indicator is drawn. 1.0 is the token edge.

IndicatorModeNpc.Name: Indicator visibility (NPC)
IndicatorModeNpc.Hint: When to show the indicator on tokens without a player owner.

IndicatorModePc.Name: Indicator visibility (PC)
IndicatorModePc.Hint: When to show the indicator on tokens owned by a player.

IndicatorShape.Name: Indicator shape
IndicatorShape.Hint: Shape used to draw the facing indicator.

CombatOnly.Name: Only during combat
CombatOnly.Hint: Show indicators only while a combat is running.

HideOnDefeated.Name: Hide on defeated tokens
HideOnDefeated.Hint: Hide the indicator on tokens with the defeated status.

LockToGrid.Name: Snap facing to the grid
LockToGrid.Hint: Limit facing to grid directions: 8 on square grids, 6 on hex grids.

FlipOrRotate.Name: Turn mode
FlipOrRotate.Hint: How tokens turn when they move: rotate the token or mirror its art. Can be overridden per token.

FacingDirection.Name: Default facing
FacingDirection.Hint: The direction token art faces by default. Can be overridden per token.

RotationOffset.Name: Rotation offset (degrees)
RotationOffset.Hint: Added to the computed rotation in Rotate mode. Use it for art that does not face down.

FlipDisabled.Name: Disable turn animation?
FlipDisabled.Hint: The module will not mirror this token and will not drive its rotation: the turn follows Foundry's own automatic rotation settings. You can still rotate or flip the token by hand.
